description: Sentinel Asia is a data repository run by Asia-Pacific Regional Space Agency Forum (APRSAF) with JAXA. Sentinel Asia shares satellite emergency observation data and damage-mapping products for disasters in Asia and the Pacific, with an archive of past activations and images. Coverage: Asia and the Pacific. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as geotiff, pdf; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account.
